topicHubs.title: The Jujutsu Kaisen Universe
topicHubs.subtitle: Complete guide to the Jujutsu Kaisen universe - characters, timeline, watch order, explanations, and everything you need to know.
topicHubs.overview: Jujutsu Kaisen is a dark fantasy anime series created by Gege Akutami. The story follows Yuji Itadori, a high school student who becomes the vessel of the powerful cursed spirit Sukuna. The series explores themes of death, morality, and the nature of curses.
topicHubs.storySummary: The story begins when Yuji Itadori, a high school student with incredible physical abilities, encounters a cursed object - a rotting finger belonging to the powerful curse Sukuna. When his friends are attacked by curses, Yuji consumes the finger to gain power and save them. This makes him the vessel of Sukuna, and he joins the Tokyo Metropolitan Jujutsu High School to learn how to control this power while hunting down curses.

articles.title: 10 Years Later: Why BoJack Horseman Remains Unmatched
articles.subtitle: How a satirical cartoon about a washed-up sitcom horse became the definitive modern character study on trauma and responsibility.

sections.content: When BoJack Horseman first debuted, critics initially dismissed it as another cynical adult animated comedy relying on Hollywood puns and talking animals. However, as the series progressed through the mid-2010s, it transformed into one of the most structurally ambitious and emotionally devastating shows in television history.
Subverting the Sitcom Formula

Unlike traditional episodic television where character actions reset by the next episode, BoJack enforced real consequences. Trauma lingered, relationships eroded permanently, and self-destructive behavior was never sanitized for laugh tracks.

sections.caption: The View from Halfway Down remains one of animation's most haunting episodes.

sections.quoteText: You can't keep doing shitty things, and then feel bad about yourself like that makes it okay. You need to be better.
sections.author: Todd Chavez

sections.content: Legacy & Cultural Impact

A decade after its premiere, the series continues to drive online discourse, TikTok visual essays, and screenwriting analyses regarding how to write flawed, irredeemable characters without glorifying their toxic traits.

quickGuideDetails.title: DC's Absolute Universe Explained for Casuals
quickGuideDetails.subtitle: How the Absolute line differs from Prime Earth, key character redesigns, and where to start.

sections.heading: What is the Absolute Universe?
sections.content: Born out of Darkseid's influence, the Absolute Universe is an alternate continuity where DC heroes lack their traditional safety nets. Superman has no Kent family farm, Wonder Woman was raised in Hell, and Batman has no fortune.

sections.heading: Absolute Batman's Key Differences
sections.content: Bruce Wayne is a blue-collar city engineer instead of a billionaire playboy. His suit is modular tactical armor built from structural steel, and his massive battle-axe emblem doubles as a heavy demolition tool.

sections.heading: Reading Order Recommendation
sections.content: Start directly with Absolute Power #4 for the universe's birth, followed by Absolute Batman #1, Absolute Superman #1, and Absolute Wonder Woman #1.

quickGuideDetails.title: Jujutsu Kaisen: Cursed Energy & Domain Expansion Breakdown
quickGuideDetails.subtitle: Understanding negative emotions, innate techniques, binding vows, and domain mechanics.

sections.heading: Cursed Energy vs. Cursed Technique
sections.content: Cursed energy is raw electricity generated by negative human emotion. A Cursed Technique is the specific appliance that runs on that electricity (e.g., Gojo's Limitless or Megumi's Ten Shadows).

sections.heading: Domain Expansion Mechanics
sections.content: By constructing a barrier with cursed energy and manifesting their innate domain, sorcerers gain a guaranteed-hit factor for their techniques within that space.
